observations: What I read: this request's first reading and required transitions, plus the page-02 script (panels 02-1 to 02-4, which appear in request 01's boundary context with the same text), source/original.txt and the revision notes. Images I opened with Read and looked at: workflow/review/page-02.png and assets/panels/02-3.png, plus page-01.png and page-03.png for the boundaries. I did not open 02-1, 02-2 or 02-4 panel art separately; I judged them from the lettered page.

The text matches the source exactly. 02-1 caption: 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' 02-1 label: 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. 02-2 Ananya: 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' 02-3 Meera: 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' 02-3 label: 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. 02-4 Ananya: 'One team. Better coordination.' The 'And...' line correctly continues Ananya's 02-2 line.

The 02-3 WELBUK CARE label against Meera's hand, checked in the art. The panel art is 832x1232, scaled to the 352x520 rect at page (648,568). In the art, Meera's relaxed left hand is at about x655-700, y960-1035, which maps to page x925-944, y974-1006. On page-02.png the label's right edge is at about x898, so there is a clear gap of about 25 px. The hand and fingers are fully visible to the right of the label. The phone hand (protected rect 794,794,40,61) is far above the label. The label covers only the lower kurta front and lies just below the laptop's base, so no face, hand or key prop is hidden.

Tails: in 02-2 the tail tip ends at Ananya's hair just above the ear (about x360, y720), outside the face rect 365-470. In 02-3 the tail points down to Meera's head top. In 02-4 the tail ends at the edge of Ananya's hair and cheek (about x400, y1237), at the outer edge of her face rect (325-397), not over her features. It points to the doctor, not to Meera on the right. That is correct, because the script gives the line to Ananya.

Fit: 'here.' ends about 20 px from its balloon edge, 'role.' about 12 px from its edge, and 'staff' about 10 px from the label edge. All text sits inside its box. The caption's 'its / Welbuk / onboarding.' break follows the scripted textColumns. It is uneven but legible, and the meaning is unaffected.

Natural scan: the top-left caption, then the top-right teal WELBUK PRACTICE label at the same height, then the middle-left balloon. Next comes the middle-right balloon, whose top is at the same height as the left one, followed by the WELBUK CARE label low in the same panel. The bottom balloon is last. The 02-2 and 02-3 balloons are separated by a gutter and point to different figures, so they do not merge.

The teal product labels look clearly different from the white caption and speech balloons, so readers take them as product names, not speech. Each label sits in the panel showing that product: the laptop with Practice, the phone with Care.

transitions.observation: The busy daytime reception cuts to the evening office, where Ananya is typing on the onboarding form. The caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' and the sunset window mark the time change. Her decision on page 1 leads into this action.
Same evening, same office and window. The view moves from over her shoulder at the screen to the front, as she pauses with a finger at her chin and states what Practice organises.

Same room: the desk, the laptop showing the blank form and the sunset window appear behind Meera. 'And our team...' adds the staff side to Ananya's statement, and the phone with a calendar icon is the new prop.
Same moment, now a two-shot. Meera still holds the staff phone at her side and Ananya is seated by the laptop, closing the pair's exchange with 'One team. Better coordination.'
The 03-1 caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.' and the bright reception mark the move from evening onboarding to a later working morning (checked on page-03.png).

readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order (caption, top-right label, the doctor's line, the receptionist's 'And...' line with its label, the doctor's closing line) is the same as the script order 02-1[1,2], 02-2[1], 02-3[1,2], 02-4[1]; no reply is missing. Concerns, each judged: (1) The WELBUK CARE label close to Meera's hanging left hand. I mapped the panel art to the page: the hand is at page x925-944 and the label ends at about x898, so the hand is not clipped and this is acceptable. (2) 'here.', 'role.' and 'staff' close to their right borders. All are inside with 10-20 px margins, so this is acceptable. (3) The awkward 'its / Welbuk / onboarding.' break. It is legible and the meaning is unchanged, so I do not count it as an issue. (4) In 02-2 and 02-4 the tails end at the hair or cheek edge. Neither covers the eyes, nose or mouth, and both clearly point to Ananya as scripted, so this is acceptable. (5) Day to sunset without a 'later' caption. The onboarding caption marks the new activity and the light shows the time, so this is acceptable. No unresolved differences.
